title: XEDO planning trial input envelope
description: Read-only calculation input, not a persisted MissionPlan or hardware command. Empty/missing settings produce progressive incomplete results. Nested calculator properties are intentionally partial contracts: see /docs/planning-trial.md and runtime for units, limits, defaults and missing-value rules. Unknown top-level fields are rejected. Saved surveyId and replacement geometry cannot both be non-null.

anyOf.description: A closed simple WGS84 ring with 3–120 vertices and no holes. Runtime validates closure, self-intersection, area and the trial latitude/date-line limits.

drift.description: Manual constant-vector scenario: observedAt/arriveAt/endAt ISO times; currentEastMps/currentNorthMps; 10 m windSpeedMps and windFromDeg (FROM true north); alpha/alphaMin/alphaMax and marginM.

flight.description: Camera sensorWidthMm/sensorHeightMm/focalLengthMm, imageWidthPx/imageHeightPx, sideOverlap/frontOverlap, altitudeM (AGL), speedMps (ground), minTriggerIntervalS; true-east/north wind components and limits; usableWh/reserveWh/powerW, takeoffS/landingS/turnS; manual home [longitude,latitude]. Optional planningProfile records eight field ownership/source assumptions and enables bounded battery-aware track selection without replacing geometry, Home or weather.

export.description: Manual homeAmslM, firmware, qgcVersion, relativeHeightM/ceilingM, limitReference, flatSurfaceConfirmed/homeConfirmed/airspaceReviewed, source, plannedTakeoffAt/optional plannedEndAt/validUntil, reviewed noGo and corridorM. Home comes only from flight.home. Invalid or missing review values can produce a blocked/incomplete report in a 200 calculation. Normal UI uses planning_reference with its own explicit planningReviewed; strict checks remain independent. New /planning-export uses shared reference checks; /export remains strict.

oil.description: Independent oil areaM2 or pixelCount + gsdM/gsdYM in metres per pixel, thicknessLowUm/thicknessHighUm, densityGml, capacityGg, allowance, targetFraction, emulsion/oilFraction. The route/search area is not inferred as oil area.

sortieIndex.description: Used only by export. Omitted or null selects zero; otherwise must be a nonnegative integer below the assessed sortie count. Calculation does not interpret this field.
